author: Lauren Kirschberg
text: Thank you for posting this! Amazing work!! You are about 6 months ahead of me on a the same mission. Do you remember what your numbers were like when you were 5-6 weeks in? Like how long did they take to trend downward. Also love to know how you changed your diet.

author: Spencer Skaats
text: Totally agree with your assessment.  The personal accountability is great.  I just hate the false lows that wake me up at 3 AM.  Great job on your journey!
